design_note: Gate 7A adds compact Korean retrieval descriptors and multilingual semantic retrieval while retaining the source-grounded English paraphrases and exact official provenance from Gate 6. Full legal text is not reproduced.

records.title: Medical Service Act
records.authority: Ministry of Health and Welfare / National Law Information Center
records.text_en: Patients may request access to their own medical records. Healthcare personnel and institutions generally may not disclose a patient's records to other persons unless a legally specified exception applies.
records.retrieval_text_ko: 환자 진료기록 열람 사본 발급 의료기관 기록 공개 제3자 제공

records.title: Personal Information Security Measures Standard
records.text_en: The standard establishes minimum technical, managerial, and physical safeguards for protecting personal information against loss, theft, leakage, forgery, alteration, or damage, and defines access-record concepts for personal-information systems.
records.retrieval_text_ko: 개인정보 보호 기술적 관리적 물리적 안전조치 접근통제 접속기록 무결성

records.title: Personal Information Protection Act
records.retrieval_text_ko: 개인정보는 원래 수집·이용 목적의 범위를 넘어 이용하거나 제3자에게 제공하는 것이 제한되며, 별도 동의나 법률상 근거 등 예외 사유가 필요하다.
records.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Personal Information Protection Commission
records.text_en: Use or third-party disclosure of personal information beyond the original collection/use purpose is restricted unless an applicable legal exception, separate consent, or other statutory basis exists.

records.title: Personal Information Protection Act
records.retrieval_text_ko: 개인정보의 제3자 제공은 정보주체의 동의 또는 법률상 허용되는 범위 등 적법한 근거가 있을 때 가능하며, 제공받는 자와 이용 목적 등 관련 사항을 고지해야 한다.
records.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Personal Information Protection Commission
records.text_en: Third-party provision of personal information requires a lawful basis, such as data-subject consent or another statutory authorization, with relevant disclosure-purpose information handled accordingly.

records.title: Bioethics and Safety Act
records.retrieval_text_ko: 인간대상연구는 원칙적으로 연구대상자의 적법한 동의를 전제로 하며, 동의 능력이 불완전한 경우에는 법에서 정한 대리 동의 요건을 따라야 한다.
records.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Ministry of Health and Welfare
records.text_en: Human-subject research is generally grounded in valid participant consent, with statutory surrogate-consent requirements applying when the participant lacks full consent capacity.

records.title: Bioethics and Safety Act
records.retrieval_text_ko: 인체유래물연구 동의에는 연구 목적, 개인정보 보호·처리, 제공, 보존·폐기, 동의 철회와 철회 시 처리 등에 관한 사항이 포함되어야 한다.
records.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Ministry of Health and Welfare
records.text_en: Consent for human-derived-material research includes the research purpose, personal-information handling, provision, retention/disposal, and withdrawal of consent and handling after withdrawal.

records.title: Digital Medical Products Act
records.retrieval_text_ko: 디지털의료기기는 지능정보기술 등 디지털기술이 적용되어 진단·치료·예후 관찰, 치료 반응·결과 예측, 치료 효과·부작용 모니터링 등에 사용되는 의료기기를 포함한다.
records.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Ministry of Food and Drug Safety
records.text_en: Digital medical devices include devices applying digital technologies for diagnosis, treatment, prognosis observation, prediction of treatment response/results, and monitoring of therapeutic effects or adverse effects.

records.title: Enforcement Rule of the Digital Medical Products Act
records.retrieval_text_ko: 디지털의료기기 임상시험계획 승인 신청에는 소프트웨어 검증·유효성, 전자적 침해행위 보호조치, 성능 및 안전 확인을 위한 자료 등 안전성 검토 자료가 요구된다.
records.authority: Korea Ministry of Government Legislation / Ministry of Food and Drug Safety
records.text_en: Digital-medical-device clinical-trial applications require safety-review materials including software verification/validation, protection against cyber compromise, and evidence supporting performance and safety.
